# Nepali Patro — Nepal Bank Interest Rates

## Canonical resource
- https://apps.laxmannepal.com.np/Nepali-Patro/interest-rate/

## Machine-readable current dataset
- https://apps.laxmannepal.com.np/Nepali-Patro/feeds/interest_rates/current.json

## Historical snapshots
- https://apps.laxmannepal.com.np/Nepali-Patro/feeds/interest_rates/history.json

## Section sitemap
- https://apps.laxmannepal.com.np/Nepali-Patro/interest-rate/sitemap-interest-rates.xml

## Bank pages
- Each bank has a dedicated page under /interest-rate/bank/.

## Methodology
- Prefer the bank's official published interest-rate source.
- Preserve source URL, effective date and fetch timestamp where available.
- Normalize savings, fixed-deposit, recurring-deposit, call-deposit, loan and base-rate records.
- Do not invent or silently infer missing rates.
- Records that fail semantic validation remain in review/error status.
- A rate should be treated as current only when its source is successfully fetched and validated.
